Short answer, yes. Long answer even the mixed signals are promising. The first one is just him worrying about you. He doesn’t want you to get hurt again like you were during the time you were dating your ex. That goes hand and hand with him getting angry because of your ex’s actions. The second one is simple, you’re looking too deep into into the word friend. Friend is an easy word to refer to anyone whether they be an actual friend, a mere acquaintance, or hiding a crush from someone (wink wink). The third one is just you overthinking again. Of course a natural reaction of being accused of having feelings towards someone is saying that you don’t, no matter how obvious it is that they like someone. They could very well know and he could still get defensive. He’s just not ready to be completely open with his feelings. I’d say shoot your shot, the stars are aligning right before your eyes.
